title: Motor neuron disorders other than ALS
summary: Motor neuron disorders (other than ALS) including spinal muscular atrophy, primary lateral sclerosis, progressive muscular atrophy, with motor disorganization OR bulbar dysfunction OR respiratory dysfunction OR marked limitation pattern.

children.criterion: Motor neuron disorder other than ALS, documented by clinical findings, EMG, and/or genetic testing
Motor disorganization OR bulbar/respiratory dysfunction OR marked limitation pattern
Disorganization of motor function in two extremities with extreme limitation in standing, balancing, or using upper extremities
Bulbar and neuromuscular dysfunction with significant difficulty swallowing, breathing, or speaking
Significant respiratory motor function impairment requiring respiratory support
Marked limitation in physical functioning AND in one mental functioning area
Marked limitation in one mental functioning area
